references.text: Moses encourages the people to bring offerings for the sanctuary, which is the background for the abundant giving mentioned in 36:7
Describes how the children of Israel brought voluntary gifts for the Lord's work, leading to the abundance noted in 36:7
The immediate context where the craftsmen receive the gifts and report that the people are bringing more than enough
Under King Hezekiah, the people brought abundant offerings to the temple, resulting in surplus, similar to the situation in Exodus
The churches of Macedonia gave generously out of their poverty, demonstrating the same principle of cheerful and abundant giving
God is able to give you all grace in abundance, so that you always have enough of everything and have plenty for every good work
Paul describes how the Philippians gave abundantly for his needs, and God will fill all their needs according to His riches
